notes: Round 3 closes review-2 findings A-D. A: the gateway.status delivery-safety inference is deleted; every failed chat.send is classified retryable / terminal-message / write-path-unknown (unknown is the default), only an all-terminal attempt streak may discard, and every discard writes a durable bounded dead-letter record (message id, conversation id, classification, attempts, ISO timestamp, summary) in the cursor store, observable via the deadLetters getter. B: early-return paths in recoverMissedMessages reschedule with backoff (recoveryRetryPending is observable); only an empty channel config returns without rescheduling. C: retainRecoveryCursors quarantines rather than deletes unrecoverable watermarks, bounded to 100 entries oldest-first, and recovery reads the quarantined watermark on re-add. D: the per-pass persistence NIT is documented at the advanceRecovered call site. Recovery still does not backfill threads/DMs (needs Discord thread enumeration, out of scope); their watermarks are bounded by the quarantine cap. Each new test was verified to fail under a targeted source mutation. The full package run emits an expected session-rebind startup-failure diagnostic from its existing test scenario; the suite completed with zero failing tests.
